source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 2 词表(p70-71 真词,△超纲词与专有名词跳过)+ 课文 Animals 主题相关常见词;IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、动物/动物园/保护主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Illegal hunting puts many wild animals in danger.
words.example_cn: 非法狩猎使许多野生动物处于危险之中。

words.meaning_cn: 灭绝的;绝种的;不再存在的
words.example_en: Some species would become extinct without help from zoos.
words.example_cn: 如果没有动物园的帮助,有些物种就会灭绝。

words.example_en: Zoos help to save many animals from extinction.
words.example_cn: 动物园帮助许多动物免于灭绝。

words.example_en: Zoos protect animals; moreover, they teach visitors about wildlife.
words.example_cn: 动物园保护动物;此外,它们还向游客介绍野生动物。

words.example_en: Many zoos attempt to copy an animal's natural habitat.
words.example_cn: 许多动物园试图仿造动物的自然栖息地。

words.example_en: A range of materials is used to build a space like the wild.
words.example_cn: 人们用多种材料来打造一个像野外的空间。

words.example_en: Lots of toys are put in exhibitions to keep the animals busy.
words.example_cn: 展区里放了许多玩具,好让动物们不无聊。

words.example_en: Tropical animals are typically kept in warm tanks.
words.example_cn: 热带动物通常被养在温暖的水槽里。

words.meaning_cn: (贮放液体或气体的)箱;槽;罐;水族箱
words.example_en: The fish were kept in a clean, heated tank.
words.example_cn: 这些鱼被养在干净的、加热过的水族箱里。

words.example_en: Every zoo has a slightly different way of caring for animals.
words.example_cn: 每个动物园照料动物的方式都略有不同。

words.example_en: This zoo has a kind approach to animal care.
words.example_cn: 这家动物园对动物护理有一套善待的方法。

words.meaning_cn: 总体上;大致上;一般来说
words.example_en: Overall, I think good zoos do more good than harm.
words.example_cn: 总体上,我认为好的动物园利大于弊。

words.example_en: I will definitely keep visiting good zoos.
words.example_cn: 我一定会继续参观优秀的动物园。

words.example_en: After he retired, the old man spent his days caring for a penguin.
words.example_cn: 退休后,这位老人每天都在照料一只企鹅。

words.example_en: The bird was close to death when the old man found it.
words.example_cn: 老人发现这只鸟时,它已奄奄一息。

words.example_en: He fed the penguin a daily diet of fish to make it strong.
words.example_cn: 他每天给企鹅喂鱼,让它强壮起来。

words.example_en: Good food helped the penguin get its strength up.
words.example_cn: 好的食物帮助企鹅恢复了体力。

words.example_en: The man tried to release the bird back into the sea.
words.example_cn: 那人试图把鸟放回大海。

words.example_en: He took the penguin to a nearby island in his small boat.
words.example_cn: 他用小船把企鹅带到附近的一座岛上。

words.meaning_cn: 年纪较大的;上了年纪的
words.example_en: The penguin seemed to prefer visiting the elderly man.
words.example_cn: 这只企鹅似乎更喜欢去看望那位老人。

words.meaning_cn: 震惊;惊愕;令人震惊的事
words.example_en: The animal's sudden return came as a happy shock to everyone.
words.example_cn: 这只动物的突然归来让所有人又惊又喜。

words.example_en: The old man became a kind host to the lonely penguin.
words.example_cn: 老人成了这只孤单企鹅热情的主人。

words.meaning_cn: 数量多的;多种多样的;多重的
words.example_en: There are multiple reasons why we should protect animals.
words.example_cn: 我们应当保护动物有多种原因。

words.example_en: This park keeps a wide variety of sea animals.
words.example_cn: 这座公园养着各种各样的海洋动物。

words.example_en: She gave the seal a slice of fresh fish.
words.example_cn: 她给海豹喂了一片新鲜的鱼。

words.example_en: Each animal gets one serving of food at a fixed time.
words.example_cn: 每只动物在固定时间吃一份食物。

words.example_en: Good zoos focus on the health and welfare of their animals.
words.example_cn: 好的动物园专注于动物的健康与福利。

words.example_en: The injured birds were taken to an animal rescue facility.
words.example_cn: 受伤的鸟被送到一处动物救助场所。

words.example_en: The zoo follows a clear strategy to protect rare species.
words.example_cn: 这家动物园遵循一套清晰的策略来保护稀有物种。

words.example_en: Animal migration is a fascinating natural phenomenon.
words.example_cn: 动物迁徙是一种迷人的自然现象。

words.example_en: Many endangered species are kept safe in good zoos.
words.example_cn: 许多濒危物种在优秀的动物园里得到保护。

words.example_en: Zoos try to build spaces like an animal's natural habitat.
words.example_cn: 动物园努力打造像动物自然栖息地的空间。

words.example_en: We visited a wildlife park to see animals up close.
words.example_cn: 我们去了一座野生动物园近距离观察动物。

words.example_en: Students learn about endangered animals at the zoo.
words.example_cn: 学生们在动物园了解濒危动物。

words.meaning_cn: 保护;保育;(自然资源的)保存
words.example_en: Zoos take part in many conservation projects.
words.example_cn: 动物园参与许多保护项目。

words.example_en: Illegal hunting is a serious threat to wild animals.
words.example_cn: 非法狩猎是对野生动物的严重威胁。

words.example_en: Every good zoo cares about animal welfare.
words.example_cn: 每家好的动物园都关心动物福利。

words.meaning_cn: 威胁;恐吓;构成威胁的事物
words.example_en: Climate change is a real threat to many species.
words.example_cn: 气候变化是许多物种面临的真正威胁。

words.example_en: Visiting zoos provides essential funding for conservation.
words.example_cn: 参观动物园为保护工作提供了必要的资金。

words.example_en: Some people think it is cruel to keep animals in cages.
words.example_cn: 有些人认为把动物关在笼子里很残忍。

words.example_en: For many people, a zoo is a good alternative to the wild.
words.example_cn: 对许多人来说,动物园是野外不错的替代选择。

words.example_en: A trip to the zoo can be both educational and fun.
words.example_cn: 去动物园既有教育意义又有趣。

words.example_en: Injured animals are taken to a rescue centre nearby.
words.example_cn: 受伤的动物被送往附近的救助中心。

words.example_en: We hope for a harmonious relationship between humans and animals.
words.example_cn: 我们希望人类与动物之间有和谐的关系。

words.example_en: Every year the penguin became more affectionate towards the man.
words.example_cn: 每年这只企鹅对老人都变得更加亲昵。

words.example_en: The aquarium keeps thousands of sea animals in clean tanks.
words.example_cn: 这座水族馆把成千上万的海洋动物养在干净的水槽里。
